summary: In the closing days of an election, {person} publicly credits a president from the other party for storm relief.
realLife: New Jersey governor Chris Christie praised Barack Obama’s response to the storm just before the 2012 election.
gates: Governments led by different parties took part in the same storm response.
weights: A recent delivery that residents can see favors public acknowledgment.
inGame: needs: who received credit for disaster assistance.

turns.what: The governor publicly asks the president to correct a delay.
turns.pulledBy: A promised shipment has missed its delivery date.
turns.writesBack: The public request cites the outstanding shipment.

turns.what: The governor thanks the crews while reserving judgment on the federal response.
turns.pulledBy: Delivery records show some towns are still waiting.
turns.writesBack: The remarks identify which deliveries remain outstanding.
